title: The Mystery of the Changing Wardrobe
text: Have you ever wondered why we pack away our warm, fuzzy sweaters in some months, and bring out our colorful raincoats in others? Why do we love ice cream sometimes, but crave hot soup at other times?

title: Think Like a Scientist!
text: What would happen if the weather stayed exactly the same every single day of the year? Would we be able to grow all our favorite fruits like mangoes and apples?

content.title: The Earth's Dance
content.description: Imagine Earth dancing around the Sun! As it spins and moves, different parts get closer to the Sun's warm hug.

title: What are Seasons?
text: When the weather stays the same for a few months, we call it a **Season**. Mother Nature gives us five beautiful seasons: Summer, Monsoon (Rainy), Autumn, Winter, and Spring.

content.definition: A time of the year when the weather stays mostly the same for a few months.

content.question: What do we call a period when the weather stays the same for a few months?

content.title: Your Reflection Time
content.text: Close your eyes and think of your favorite season. Can you explain to your friends why you love it the most? What do you play or eat during that time?

title: Connecting the Dots
text: Seasons are connected to the clothes we wear, the food we eat, and even the festivals we celebrate! Just like a clock has numbers, a year has seasons that keep repeating.

content.title: Mastery Challenge: The Season Detective
content.text: Look out of your window right now. Look at the trees, the sky, and what people are wearing. Can you identify which season it is today?

content.tip: Encourage students to relate seasons to their own lives, like summer holidays or wearing raincoats to school.

content.mistake: Students often think a season changes every day. Remind them that seasons last for months, while weather can change daily.

title: The Tale of the Five Friends
text: Imagine five friends who take turns visiting your house every year. When one leaves, the next one arrives! Who are these friends?

title: Can You Guess?
text: Why do you think trees shed all their leaves before it gets really cold? What would happen if they kept their leaves during heavy snowfall?

content.title: The Cycle of Seasons
content.description: Watch how a single tree changes its colors from green to yellow, drops its leaves, and then blooms with new flowers!

title: Meet the Five Seasons
text:
1. **Summer**: Hot and sunny! We eat ice cream and wear cotton clothes.
2. **Monsoon**: Rainy and wet! We use umbrellas and wear raincoats.
3. **Autumn**: Breezy and colorful! Trees drop their dry leaves.
4. **Winter**: Cold and chilly! We wear sweaters and drink hot milk.
5. **Spring**: Bright and beautiful! New flowers bloom everywhere.

content.definition: The season when it rains heavily.
The season when leaves turn yellow and fall from trees.

content.question: In which season do we use umbrellas and wear raincoats?
What do trees do in Autumn?

content.title: Reflection: Teach a Sibling
content.text: Imagine you have to explain the five seasons to a younger sibling or friend. What special thing would you tell them about Spring?

title: Connecting to the Real World
text: Farmers depend on the seasons! They plant seeds before the Monsoon so the rain can water their crops, and they harvest in other seasons. Nature works as a perfect team!

content.title: Mastery Challenge: The Festival Planner
content.text: Think of a festival like Diwali or Holi. Which season do they happen in? Draw your favorite festival and write the name of the season next to it!
